description:
Fixes #14265

# User-Facing Changes

`ls` without a path argument now errors when the current working directory is unreadable due to missing permissions:

```diff
mkdir foo
chmod 100 foo
cd foo
ls | to nuon
-[]
+Error:   × Permission denied
```

comments.body: Just one thing, I think you can make a separate `assert!`.  It's easier to know which assertion failed.

I think there may be a minor TOCTOU risk of this panicking if the directory is deleted between the raising of the error and hitting `File::metadata` which runs a `statx()` syscall on the file descriptor. 

Not quite sure how I feel about showing the octal mode repr here. Certainly more informative than bare permission denied but at the same time somewhat cryptic for folks not brought up with old `chmod`. And also not sure if it can properly represent dernied permissions due to ACLs.
